name: ubuntu/desktop-entry
title: App launcher (.desktop)
summary: Launcher (.desktop file), icon and an install script for any program.
when: Use when a program already runs from the terminal and the user wants an icon in the GNOME app grid.

name.about: Name under the icon, and the file name of the .desktop file and the icon.

command.about: Program the launcher starts, with arguments; absolute path if it is not on PATH.

next: Write every file under files/ into the user's project, set name, command and the icon to the user's program, then run ./install.sh and look for the icon in the app grid.
